{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Drop refunded orders (keep only completed)
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
total_by_segment = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].count()
converted_by_segment = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_by_segment = (converted_by_segment / total_by_segment) * 100

# Print the full conversion rate by segment
conversion_rate_by_segment"}
